title: Week of May 18 — Institutional MSFT, AAPL ATH, NVDA Earnings Week

macro.iran: Ceasefire holding but fragile. Peace talks stalled — uranium enrichment deadlock. Pakistan mediating. Any escalation reopens Hormuz risk immediately.
macro.bonds: 30Y yield spiked to 5.11% Friday — multi-year high. Jerome Powell's last day as Fed chair. New Fed chair unknown quantity. Yields are the primary macro headwind.
macro.oil: Above $109. Iran war floor holding. China crude deal adds upward pressure.
macro.china: Trump-Xi summit concluded. Trade stabilization not breakthrough. $30B tariff relief — less than 10% of bilateral trade. Tim Cook, Jensen Huang, Elon Musk in delegation. China narrative benefits AAPL most.
macro.nvdaEarnings: Wednesday May 20. IV expanding all week. No overnight holds Monday or Tuesday. 0DTE or same-day only.
macro.ackman: Bill Ackman Pershing Square disclosed new MSFT position Friday May 15. Called recent pullback a rare opportunity at 21x forward earnings — in line with market, well below historical average. Primary catalyst for MSFT relative strength on red day.
